title: TribunalMC
description: Your players are under you laws!
body:
# ⚖️ Tribunal ### *Order in the court.* ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-gold) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.x-green) ![Ecosystem](https://img.shields.io/badge/Suite-CivCraft-orange) **The final word.** *Tribunal is a sophisticated legal system that allows players to hold real trials, elect judges, and enforce laws beyond simple bans.* ![Banner](https://iili.io/BUyTTLx.md.png)
--- ## 🏛️ The Concept Stop relying on admins to settle disputes. **Tribunal** provides the tools for player-run justice. From electing a Supreme Judge to managing a Jury of peers, every conflict becomes a high-stakes roleplay event with tangible consequences. --- ## ✨ Key Features * **Physical Courtrooms:** Designate zones for the Judge, the Accused, and the Jury. The plugin manages "Order of Speech" automatically. * **Sentencing Engine:** Judges can issue fines, temporary jail time, "Community Service" (mining tasks), or public executions. * **Election System:** A democratic voting module to choose who holds the Gavel for the season. --- ## 🔗 CivCraft Suite Integration | Integration | Synergy Effect | |-------------|----------------| | 🕵️ **Witness** | "Testimony Books" are officially imported as exhibits A, B, and C in the trial. | | ⚔️ **ReanimateMC** | A "Downed" player can be "Handcuffed" and teleported directly to the Defendant's dock. | | 🪦 **Epitaph** | Executed criminals get a specific "Traitor's Grave" that cannot be honored. | ---
*Crime. Witnesses. Bounties. Reputation. Trials. Graves.* **This is CivCraft.**
